appearances.title: Vals AI adds Watershed, a realistic AWS cloud scenario, to its CyberOffense eval; Opus 5.5 leads at 77.1% average
appearances.summary: Watershed simulates a Kubernetes cluster, ECS hosts and real cloud identities and policies. Across Nova, Lighthouse and Watershed, Opus 5.5 averages 77.1% and GPT-6 Sol Daybreak 65.9%; on Watershed no model earned all nine stages (Opus 5.5 averaged 55.7 of 100).
